concerns.text: T003 is tagged [P] but computes 'the per-taxon linear slope of CLR-transformed abundance', consuming `data/processed/clr_abundances.parquet` produced by T002 (also tagged [P]). This is a hidden producer-before-consumer dependency: T002 and T003 cannot safely run in parallel. Remove the [P] tag from T003 (or from T002) and state the T002→T003 edge explicitly in the execution-order note.

T008 is tagged [P] but its own description executes 'ingest → preprocess → slopes → correlation → mixed effects → permutation', i.e. it depends on the completion of T001–T007, several of which are also tagged [P] (T001–T003). A [P] task that consumes outputs of other [P] tasks is not parallel-safe. Drop the [P] tag or scope it to 'safe to run after T001–T007 complete'.

T009 is tagged [P] but its verification runs 'against the real output files' generated by T008 (and T004–T006). Same unsafe-[P] pattern: T009 must be ordered after T008; remove the [P] tag or make the ordering precondition explicit.
